title: Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing
abstract: arXiv:2609.37402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routing reduces serving cost by assigning each query to an appropriate model while preserving response quality. Learning such a router, however, often requires executing multiple candidate models on historical queries to collect query--model quality feedback, creating a nontrivial supervision cost before deployment. Existing work largely focuses on serving-time efficiency, overlooking whether the resulting savings are sufficient to recover this upfront expenditure. We further observe that routing quality often saturates well before all query--model feedback is collected, suggesting that dense supervision can be economically over-provisioned. We propose SaveRouter, a sparse-supervision routing framework that selectively acquires informative model feedback and shares capability information across related queries, while retaining query-level refinement for fine-grained routing. translated_title: 路由应能自负盈亏：面向经济型LLM路由的稀疏监督方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）路由通过将每个查询分配给合适的模型来降低服务成本，同时保持响应质量。然而，学习这样的路由器通常需要在历史查询上执行多个候选模型，以收集查询-模型质量反馈，这在部署前产生了不可忽视的监督成本。现有工作大多只关注服务时的效率，忽视了由此带来的节省是否足以收回这笔前期投入。我们进一步观察到，路由质量往往在所有查询-模型反馈收集完毕之前就已达到饱和，这表明密集监督在经济上可能是过度配置的。我们提出SaveRouter，一个稀疏监督路由框架，它选择性地获取有信息量的模型反馈，并在相关查询之间共享模型能力信息，同时保留查询级别的精细化以实现细粒度路由。我们通过联合核算（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SaveRouter稀疏监督路由框架，通过选择性获取有价值的模型反馈并在相关查询间共享模型能力信息，在保证路由质量的同时大幅降低路由器的训练监督成本，使LLM路由带来的服务成本节省足以覆盖其前期投入。
en_tdlr: SaveRouter is a sparse-supervision LLM routing framework that selectively acquires informative model feedback and shares capability information across related queries, ensuring that routing's upfront supervision cost is economically recovered by its serving-time savings.
